generationVerdict.label: new_generation_shell
generationVerdict.summary: Forge delivers a structural next-gen shell (icon rail + branded header + two-column workspace + mission CTA panel + equal Light/Dark). This is not «same card stack, new colors». Control-level polish and Help/Convert overlays still lag the shell — commercial quality is above prior utility LOGER, below NEXUS/Cloudio reference drama.

vsReferences.nexusDark: Yellow accent discipline and dark charcoal hierarchy are on-brand; missing glass depth, richer elevated surfaces, and denser mission storytelling.
vsReferences.cloudioLight: Airy Canvas/Surface cards and yellow CTA/nav highlight align; missing refined rail frame, softer component chrome, and premium secondary controls.

issues.title: Mission checklist is static copy, not live readiness
issues.description: DESIGN.md mission panel is «checklist + ready + CTA». Live «Запуск» shows four bullet steps as plain text with no check/skip/ready state as the user fills Источник / Посылки / Результат. The panel teaches but does not reflect progress.
issues.probableCause: Mission panel bound to static Label text rather than form validation state.
issues.recommendation: Drive checklist rows from path/validation state (empty / ready / error) using Muted → Text → Success tokens; keep yellow for Primary CTA only. Optional: disable or mute CTA until minimum ready set.
acceptanceCriteria: Each mission step visually reflects current readiness
CTA remains Primary yellow when actionable; disabled/muted state is obvious without yellow-as-error
Works in Light and Dark
issues.implementerNote: UpdateReadyHint wired to path TextChanged; ✓/• live marks; Success when all ready. After screenshots: ui-audit/screenshots/after/ (auditor VERIFY).
issues.auditorNote: VERIFY live: empty checklist uses •; after filling Источник/Посылки/Результат textboxes all four rows flip to ✓. Works Light and Dark. Snapshot Name confirms ✓/• text.

issues.title: Primary «Обработать» looks fully armed on empty form
issues.description: Idle form shows solid Primary yellow «Обработать» while Источник, Посылки, and Результат are empty. Combined with static checklist, the CTA overpromises readiness.
issues.probableCause: CTA always styled Primary; enablement not tied to required inputs (or enabled but styled the same when disabled).
issues.recommendation: Gate IsEnabled (or visual muted Secondary) until minimum required paths exist; keep OnPrimary yellow only when actionable.
acceptanceCriteria: Empty-form CTA is visually non-primary or disabled
Ready-form CTA is unmistakable Primary
Light and Dark both clear
issues.implementerNote: Option A: Enabled stays true; Tag ThemeTags.Primary only when log+devices+output filled; else Elevated secondary via ApplyProcessButtonState. IsPrimaryNamed removed so name alone cannot force yellow.
issues.auditorNote: VERIFY live: empty-form Обработать is elevated/secondary grey (not Primary yellow). After three paths filled, CTA becomes solid Primary yellow (Light+Dark). Enabled stays clickable (Option A).

issues.title: Справка/Конвертация remain overlays over process workspace
issues.description: Forge shell adds a true nav rail, but Справка still opens owned «Помощь» over the left of the process layout (cards remain underneath). Full in-place panes deferred from prior pass. Convert not retested this run due to MCP hang.

evidence.notes: Help still owned overlay over process cards. Convert not opened (UI-F10 hang).

issues.probableCause: Nav items still launch dialogs/forms rather than swapping workspaceHost content.
issues.recommendation: Prefer in-place content panes for Help/Convert inside Forge shell; if overlays stay, ensure selection/IA story matches DESIGN (active destination).
acceptanceCriteria: Primary nav destination matches visible primary content
No process card stack competing under an active section destination
issues.auditorNote: VERIFY failed vs original AC: Справка still opens Помощь over process workspace (cards remain underneath). Convert not retested visually — Invoke hang. Forge header polish on Help is real but tracked/verified under UI-F03; does not satisfy in-place destination AC. Reopen for implementer if in-place panes still desired; otherwise re-scope AC explicitly.
issues.implementerNote: Bounded polish only per brief: Help + Convert keep overlays (DESIGN.md). Forge header (Primary mark + PageTitle) + ThemePalette surfaces applied. In-place panes still deferred.

issues.title: Help chrome still lag Forge shell
issues.description: «Помощь» is a classic tree + RichEdit document overlay. It does not reuse icon-rail language, mission surfaces, or Forge header density. Reads as a second product generation behind the main shell.
issues.probableCause: HelpForm not fully migrated to Forge surfaces / Modern* controls.
issues.recommendation: Restyle Help as Forge elevated Surface: themed tree, Section typography, Primary selection wash, shared radius tokens; optionally dock as workspace pane.
acceptanceCriteria: Help Light/Dark match ThemePalette surface hierarchy
Selection/search chrome feel native to Forge shell
issues.implementerNote: Added Forge header (Primary diamond + PageTitle), Header/Elevated tags, ThemeForm retained. Content system unchanged.
issues.auditorNote: VERIFY live: Help shows Forge header (Помощь PageTitle + Primary yellow mark), themed Light/Dark surfaces, yellow selection wash on tree. Content still tree+RichEdit — acceptable for this AC batch; closer to shell than pre-fix classic chrome.

issues.title: Duplicate yellow brand marks (header + rail)
issues.description: Solid yellow square appears both beside «LOGER» in the header and again at the top of the nav rail (navBrandMark). Creates twin brand hotspots and slightly weakens accent discipline.
issues.probableCause: Header brand mark and navBrandStrip both paint Primary diamond.
issues.recommendation: Keep one dominant mark (prefer header brand + wordmark; rail top can be spacer or subtle LOGER monogram without second full yellow square).
acceptanceCriteria: Only one primary yellow brand diamond visible at a time in default layout
Selected nav pill remains the rail’s yellow accent

issues.title: Activity console still dominates idle vertical space
issues.description: Placeholder «Журнал обработки появится здесь» is good, but the idle console band still takes a large share of the window under a short mission/workspace column — especially noticeable in Light.
issues.probableCause: Default splitter ratio still favors console height.
issues.recommendation: Lower default console fraction further; consider collapsed-by-default with peek strip until first log line.
acceptanceCriteria: On default 1080p window, workspace+mission clearly dominate idle height
Placeholder remains when collapsed/peek

issues.title: Secondary controls undercut Forge premium shell
issues.description: Path textboxes and Обзор / Создать… / Параметры / Посылки buttons read as stock WinForms chrome next to custom nav pills and Primary CTA. Light theme exposes this gap more than Dark.
issues.probableCause: Mixed Modern* CTA/nav with default Button/TextBox rendering on cards.
issues.recommendation: Unify secondary actions to ModernButton ghost/default; inputs to bordered Elevated fields with Radius.Md and Border tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Secondary buttons share one visual family across cards
Inputs match Surface/Border tokens in Light and Dark

issues.title: Dark surface elevation is too flat vs Forge atmosphere
issues.description: Dark Canvas/Surface/Elevated cards are close in value; workspace lacks the layered depth DESIGN references (elevated surfaces / soft borders). Light feels airier and more premium than Dark.
issues.probableCause: Card fill too close to Canvas; borders low-contrast; no subtle Elevated differentiation.
issues.recommendation: Increase Dark Elevated vs Canvas delta; strengthen Border on cards; keep no multi-layer shadows per DESIGN performance rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Dark cards clearly sit above Canvas without relying on heavy shadows
Light/Dark feel equally finished

issues.title: Theme control is a generic «Тема» chip
issues.description: Header right edge has a small outlined «Тема» button. Functionally fine; as a dual-theme product story it underplays Light/Dark as first-class Forge features.
issues.probableCause: Minimal text toggle without sun/moon or segmented control.
issues.recommendation: Icon+tooltip segmented Light/Dark control using Border/Primary selected state; keep AccessibleName flip text.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme control communicates current mode at a glance
UIA name remains clear for both states

issues.title: Результат card competes with mission column width
issues.description: Результат sits as a narrow mid-column card beside the stacked inputs while «Запуск» owns the far right. Save path field looks cramped vs left-column inputs; composition is readable but slightly awkward vs DESIGN «workspace (inputs + output) | mission».
issues.probableCause: cardsHost two-column grid places output beside inputs rather than stacking output into left workspace under inputs.
issues.recommendation: Either widen Result within workspace grid or stack Result under inputs in left column so mission panel is purely checklist+CTA.
acceptanceCriteria: Output path field width comparable to other path fields
Mission panel reads as dedicated CTA column

issues.title: Nav «Конвертация» Invoke hangs / unstable under Windows MCP
issues.description: Two Invoke attempts on Конвертация timed out (UIA Timeout). First hang correlated with MCP 0x80131505 and LOGER process exit. Blocks automated Convert visual audit.

evidence.notes: Functional bug for automation path; may also affect assistive Invoke. Manual click not confirmed this pass.

issues.probableCause: Modal Convert shown on UI thread blocking UIA Invoke return; or NavigationItem Invoke handler deadlock.
issues.recommendation: Ensure Convert open is async/non-blocking for UIA Invoke; verify with FlaUI Click and Invoke; add AutomationId navConvert regression.
acceptanceCriteria: FlaUI Invoke and Click both open Convert without hanging host
LOGER remains responsive after open/close
issues.auditorNote: Reconfirmed VERIFY 2026-10-08: windows_click Конвертация → UIA Timeout; MCP 0x80131505; LOGER exited. Still open.
